full_judgment: 4. The further case of the Khasru Mia was that the petitioner paid salami vide DCR dated 17-11-1975 and got delivery of possession on 18-11-1975. The land was mutated in his name in RoR khatian No. 454. The petitioner procured agricultural equipment including tractor for mechanised cultivation of the land. The petitioner brought the land under mechanised cultivation and has been regularly growing crops therein. He paid land revenue vide DCR No. 500731 dated 17-12- 1976.
